note: Playbook as DATA. Keys are the fact keys the agent uses (fact:<key>) so one answer serves every site. Nothing here is a value of any user.

resume.note: The user registers the resume once. The agent only ever names the ref 'resume'; it never sees a path. Upload uses set_input_files on the file input and reads it back; UNVERIFIED on real sites.

attestations_always_asked: I have never paid anyone for this job or training
Declaration that the information is true
Terms and conditions / privacy consent that the site presents as a legal statement
never: pay any registration, training or security fee (stop: this is a scam pattern)
type Aadhaar, PAN, passport or bank numbers
create an account without the user's ok for that site
apply when the daily cap is reached
goal_template: Apply to the job at {url} for the user. Fill the form ONLY from stored facts (fact:<key>). Fact keys used for job forms: {keys}. Upload the resume with file_ref resume. Legal statements are asked verbatim (attest). Before the final submit call request_confirmation with the job title, the company and what will be sent. Report the job title and company in finish.
